policies.review: Read the retained wildcard-agent rules. Neither the exact advanced-manufacturing path nor the security-and-privacy-notice path is excluded. No search, taxonomy, query-string, account, administrative or other disallowed path is approved. Robots compatibility is not a reuse license.

Read the retained security/privacy notice and copyright footer. This is a privacy notice, not an affirmative content-reuse or automation license. It distinguishes publicly accessible publications from resident/account/subscriber publications. Only the exact publicly accessible HTML page is included in this bounded local research check; no account, cookie session, form, analytics script, third-party resource or restricted publication is accessed. City copyright and all-rights-reserved status remain in force. State/local government authorship is not federal public-domain status. No blanket automation or redistribution permission is inferred.

rights.local_use: Bounded exact-page research observation with local retained bytes for verification; an internal review decision, not publisher-granted permission.
rights.public_output: Operational metadata and original reviewer analysis only; no raw HTML, images, attachments or substantial publisher text.

document.scope: Whole municipal advanced-manufacturing page covering multiple companies and Intel campuses. Only the paragraph explicitly naming Intel Fab 52 at Ocotillo in Chandler is relevant to the baseline unit. Other employers, two-campus employment, multi-fab investment and city-wide totals cannot be allocated to Fab 52.
document.date_review: No precise publication/update or Fab 52 event date established. Retrieval time and the privacy notice's 2018 update date must not supply either clock.
document.manufacturing_review: The unit-specific present-tense opening/production statement is a monitoring lead. It does not establish attainment of a defined high-volume-manufacturing milestone, numeric output or capacity, qualification, yield, utilization or point geometry. The baseline remains unchanged. Whole-page changes, including navigation and unrelated companies, remain text-review candidates until scope is reconciled.

validity_note: Thirty-day internal review deadline. Every recurring check must match both reviewed policy hashes; changed or failed policy checks block document requests. No automatic renewal. A missing or failed page is never negative facility evidence.
